title: Instructor Loyalty Concentration
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=peloton:yoga instructor_name=*
| stats count as classes by instructor_name
| eventstats sum(classes) as total
| eval share_pct=round(100*classes/total,1)
| sort - classes
| head 10
description: Ranks Peloton yoga instructors by class count and share of total practice time.
value: Favorite instructors are fine until one goes on leave; concentration shows whether you have backup teachers.
implementation: Export Peloton yoga history with `instructor_name` and review top-instructor share quarterly.
visualization: Pareto chart of classes by instructor.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which yoga teachers you keep going back to most often.
